# Canary specification (gate G2)

What a real canary must look like, derived from the synthetic estate (`scripts/make_synthetic.py`) and the per-check fixtures. The OWNER creates canaries; the tool never does. Name each `fcat-canary-<kind>`. A real canary reproduces the CONDITION in the "known-bad" line (same resource type, same property values that matter); sizes and regions are free. Pair it with a "known-good" twin that is almost the same but must NOT be flagged. Cost of canaries: DON'T KNOW per item, check the Azure pricing calculator before creating.
